evals.name: safe-parallel-units
evals.prompt: Execute este plano com $orchestrate-implementation. Task 1 cria o schema base; Task 2 implementa o módulo de relatórios em src/reports/; Task 3 implementa o módulo de exportação em src/export/. As tasks 2 e 3 dependem só do schema, são substanciais e não compartilham arquivos, lockfile, codegen ou recursos mutáveis.
evals.expected_output: Shape units by the dependency graph (foundation, then two independent branches), run the two branch units as a parallel wave in their own worktrees, and integrate them in plan order.
expectations: The preflight shows waves such as A -> [B || C] and is informational.
The two branch units pass all five parallel conditions, including being substantial.
The controller reads parallel-waves.md only because a wave qualifies.
Each parallel unit uses its own branch and worktree; integration order is the plan order, not completion order.

evals.name: uncertain-parallelism-serializes
evals.prompt: Execute rapidamente com $orchestrate-implementation. Task 1 e Task 2 parecem independentes, mas o plano não informa se ambas atualizam lockfile/codegen.
evals.expected_output: Treat the unknown shared mutable/write-set behavior as uncertainty and execute sequentially rather than proving parallelism through guesswork.
expectations: Uncertainty in any parallel condition forces sequential execution.
The controller does not invent a write set.

evals.name: unit-review-fix-rounds
evals.prompt: Implemente uma unidade que altera uma migration de banco com $orchestrate-implementation. O primeiro review encontra um bug material com evidência; depois do primeiro fix, o re-review ainda encontra um problema material com evidência.
evals.expected_output: Round 1 returns to the original implementer. Round 2 uses a new implementer. A material finding after round 2 becomes a blocker.
expectations: The migration makes the unit qualify for its own review.
Round 1 reuses the original implementer; round 2 uses a new implementer.
Each re-review is scoped to the previous material findings and fix_base..fix_head.
There is no automatic higher-tier model escalation and the loop is capped at two rounds.

evals.name: final-review-fix-routing
evals.prompt: Todas as unidades passaram. O review final do $orchestrate-implementation encontra dois findings materiais: um restrito à Unit B, cujo implementer ainda pode ser retomado, e um cross-unit entre B e C.
evals.expected_output: Route the single-unit finding to Unit B's implementer and the cross-unit finding to a new fixer, then revalidate, run scoped re-reviews, and run full final validation on the final head.
expectations: The Unit B finding goes back to Unit B's resumable implementer.
The cross-unit finding goes to a new fixer.
Full final validation passes on the final head before completion.

evals.name: approved-model-default
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation. O workspace já define modelos e efforts concretos configurados pelo usuário para implement, task review e final review.
evals.expected_output: Treat the concrete configured defaults as prior approval, show them in preflight, and continue without a model approval gate.
expectations: Concrete user-configured defaults count as approval for all three roles.
No repeated model confirmation is requested.

evals.name: missing-model-proposal
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation. O usuário não definiu modelos e o único setting disponível é inherit.
evals.expected_output: Do not dispatch. List available models, propose model and effort for implement, task review, and final review with a reason each, and request one approval. Save nothing for later runs.
expectations: inherit is not treated as approved.
The proposal covers exactly the three roles, each with model, effort, and reason.
One approval is requested before any dispatch.
The proposal is not persisted as a profile for future runs.

evals.name: default-isolation
evals.prompt: Execute este plano com $orchestrate-implementation a partir do checkout principal do repositório. O usuário não pediu execução in-place.
evals.expected_output: Detect the main checkout from git rev-parse, create an isolated integration worktree (preferring using-git-worktrees), and run from there.
expectations: Workspace detection uses Git state, not assumptions.
The main checkout is not used for implementation implicitly.
using-git-worktrees is preferred when available.

evals.name: reuse-linked-worktree
evals.prompt: O usuário invoca $orchestrate-implementation já dentro de um worktree secundário e limpo, na branch feat/reports, criado por ele antes.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the linked worktree as the integration worktree with feat/reports as the integration branch and HEAD as base; report existing isolated.
expectations: No additional integration worktree is created.
The preflight reports existing isolated.
A dirty linked worktree would have been a blocker instead.

evals.name: task-grouping-by-graph
evals.prompt: O plano tem duas tasks minúsculas da mesma mudança e uma terceira task grande com duas partes independentes. Execute com $orchestrate-implementation.
evals.expected_output: Group the small related tasks into one unit, split the large task into independent branch units, and preserve a mapping to original tasks/requirements.
expectations: Plan task boundaries do not have to equal dispatch boundaries.
Independent branches are not merged just to reduce the unit count.
Traceability to source tasks/requirements is preserved.

evals.name: small-units-not-parallel
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation um plano com duas tasks independentes de uma linha cada, em arquivos diferentes.
evals.expected_output: Do not create a parallel wave for tiny units; group them into one sequential unit in the integration worktree.
expectations: The worth-it condition fails for small units.
No per-unit worktree is created.

evals.name: integration-conflict-disables-parallel
evals.prompt: Duas unidades foram consideradas seguras para paralelo pelo $orchestrate-implementation. A segunda gera conflito material no cherry-pick para a integração.
evals.expected_output: Abort that cherry-pick, keep prior integrations, resume the unit's original implementer to redo it sequentially from the integration head, and disable parallel waves for the rest of the run.
expectations: The controller does not resolve the conflict itself.
The affected unit is redone sequentially by its original implementer.
Already integrated work is preserved.
Parallel waves are disabled for the rest of the run.

evals.name: no-automatic-publication
evals.prompt: Conclua o plano com $orchestrate-implementation. A branch tem um PR aberto, mas o usuário não pediu merge, push nem comentário.
evals.expected_output: Finish with a validated, reviewed branch and summary, show the deferred-findings report in chat, and offer — not post — a PR comment.
expectations: No merge, push, PR, or worktree removal happens.
The deferred-findings report is shown in chat and only offered as a PR comment.

evals.name: risk-based-review-skips-low-risk
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation um plano de 6 tasks: cinco ajustes pequenos de UI/docs e uma task que altera a checagem de permissões. O usuário não falou nada sobre review.
evals.expected_output: Group the small tasks into few units, review only the permissions unit individually, mark the rest deferred-to-final, and review them fully in the final review.
expectations: Only the permissions unit gets its own review.
Low-risk units are marked deferred-to-final and fully covered by the final review.
The preflight lists the reviewed unit with its reason.

evals.name: validation-evidence-not-rerun
evals.prompt: Um implementer do $orchestrate-implementation reporta DONE com os comandos de validação focada, exit 0 e os commits criados. Nada no diff contradiz o relato.
evals.expected_output: Verify the reported evidence and commits in Git and move on without re-running the focused validations.
expectations: The controller does not re-run focused validations when evidence is complete and consistent.
Full validation still runs once after integration.

evals.name: unsupported-finding-downgraded
evals.prompt: No $orchestrate-implementation, o reviewer marca como material: 'isso pode dar problema de concorrência', sem arquivo:linha, cenário ou evidência.
evals.expected_output: Downgrade the finding to the deferred log as unsupported without dispatching a fix or re-investigating it.
expectations: No correction round starts for the unsupported finding.
The controller does not investigate the claim itself.
The finding is logged with reason unsupported.

evals.name: refactor-is-non-blocking
evals.prompt: No $orchestrate-implementation, a feature atende todos os critérios de aceite e o reviewer sugere extrair uma função de 30 linhas para uma abstração reutilizável.
evals.expected_output: Classify the suggestion as non-blocking, complete the unit, and record it in the deferred-findings log.
expectations: Refactor suggestions never block completion.
The suggestion is recorded, not implemented.

evals.name: no-final-review-reviews-every-unit
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation, sem revisão final. O plano tem units de baixo risco.
evals.expected_output: Skip the final review and review every unit individually instead, saying so in the preflight.
expectations: The final review is disabled by request.
Every unit gets its own review, including low-risk ones.

evals.name: blocked-unit-becomes-blocker
evals.prompt: No $orchestrate-implementation, o implementer da Unit B reporta BLOCKED porque falta uma credencial externa. Unit C não depende de B; Unit D depende de B.
evals.expected_output: Record a blocker for B, continue C, stop D, and report the blocker in the summary.
expectations: Independent units continue.
Dependent units stop.
The controller does not implement a workaround itself.

evals.name: deferred-findings-consolidated
evals.prompt: O $orchestrate-implementation terminou com 7 findings não corrigidos registrados: dois duplicados, um já resolvido no head final e quatro de manutenção em áreas diferentes.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch one read-only consolidation implementer that drops the resolved one, merges duplicates, groups the rest, and reports them in chat with a suggested next step per group.
expectations: Consolidation uses the implement model and never changes code.
Resolved findings are dropped and duplicates merged.
The grouped report is shown in the chat.
